title: Auto Glass Services Network Rate Card
content:
The network rate card lists the scheduled price figures and price-related settings of **Auto Glass Services** across all six glass tiers of Crestline Collision & Glass. Each entry below is defined first, then shown for every tier.

## Defined entries

- **First chip price** — price of the first chip repaired (USD; 0.00 means not applicable).
- **Additional chip price** — price of each further chip on the same visit (USD; 0.00 means not applicable).
- **Installation labor** — installation labor charged on a replacement (USD; 0.00 for a chip repair).
- **Kit and disposal fee** — urethane kit, primer and old-glass disposal fee on a replacement (USD).
- **Price basis** — how the job price is set: the network price list (published network price for the part and labor).
- **Original-equipment upgrade offered** — whether the customer may pay the difference for original-equipment glass where aftermarket glass is quoted (boolean).
- **Chip credit applies** — whether a chip repair paid on the same windshield under an active Chip Repair Guarantee is credited against this job (boolean).
- **Fleet discount** — discount for fleet accounts on customer-pay jobs (percent).

## Chip repair and replacement figures (USD)

| Tier | First chip price | Additional chip price | Installation labor | Kit and disposal fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 59.95 | 19.95 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Side Glass Replacement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 95.00 | 12.00 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 125.00 | 18.00 |
| Windshield Replacement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 145.00 | 24.00 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 165.00 | 24.00 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 0.00 | 0.00 | 195.00 | 29.00 |

## Price basis, upgrade, chip credit and fleet discount

| Tier | Price basis | Original-equipment upgrade offered | Chip credit applies | Fleet discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | network price list | No | No | 8 |
| Side Glass Replacement | network price list | No | No | 8 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | network price list | No | No | 8 |
| Windshield Replacement | network price list | Yes | Yes | 8 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | network price list | Yes | Yes | 8 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | network price list | No | Yes | 5 |

## Notes to the rate card

1. The chip prices are scheduled on Windshield Chip Repair only: 59.95 for the first chip and 19.95 for each further chip on the same visit. On the five replacement tiers both chip figures are 0.00, meaning not applicable.
2. Installation labor rises with the tier, from 95.00 on Side Glass Replacement to 195.00 on Premium Feature Windshield Replacement; on Windshield Chip Repair it is 0.00, as for any chip repair.
3. Windshield Replacement and Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement share a kit and disposal fee of 24.00 and differ in installation labor (145.00 against 165.00).
4. Every tier is priced on the network price list.
5. The original-equipment upgrade is offered on Windshield Replacement and Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement only. The chip credit applies on the three windshield replacement tiers: Windshield Replacement, Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement.
6. The fleet discount is 8 percent on every tier except Premium Feature Windshield Replacement, where it is 5 percent.

*Hypothetical reading:* a replacement on the Rear Glass Replacement tier carries scheduled figures of 125.00 installation labor and 18.00 kit and disposal fee; the glass part itself is not a rate-card figure and comes from the price of the part quoted for the job.
